description: Tuulivoimalat Suomessa 2014 is a dataset listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ulkoinen lähde: Paikkatietohakemisto. Tuulivoimayhdistyksen sivuilla on kattavasti kerrottu tuulivoimasta ja tuulivoimaloiden toiminnasta tietoa. Tämä aineisto on poimittu yhdistyksen tuottamasta KML-datasta vuonna 2014. Coverage: Ulkoinen lähde: Paikkatietohakemisto. The publisher named on the listing is Ulkoinen lähde: Paikkatietohakemisto. Its keywords include Tuotanto- ja teollisuuslaitokset, Ei-Inspire, Alueellinen, avoindata.fi, Tuulivoima, Suomi. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
